Madhya Bharat Agro Products reports Q1 FY27 PAT growth of 17% Madhya Bharat Agro Products Ltd reported a 17% YoY increase in Profit After Tax to ₹33.0 crore for Q1 FY27, supported by revenue from operations of ₹416.3 crore. The company navigated elevated raw material prices and geopolitical uncertainties through its integrated manufacturing platform and diversified product portfolio. Operational highlights include the introduction of new NPK grades and land acquisition at the Dhule facility, with capacity utilization for SSP at 79% and NPK/DAP at 66%

Kirloskar Brothers' UK Unit SPP Pumps Wins GBP 11.7 Million Order From Saipem 2 Kirloskar Brothers' wholly owned UK subsidiary SPP Pumps Ltd has won a GBP 11,674,520 (approx. ₹149.59 crore) order from Saipem Offshore Construction SPA for the supply of vertical pumps and spares. The contract carries a Performance Bond of 10% and a Warranty Bond of 5% of the contract value, with an execution timeline of 52-60 weeks. The order involves no related party transactions and was disclosed under SEBI's Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015
